dataset: Reported flood depths at named places in Mae Sai district, 10-13 Sep 2024 (Thai and English news, paraphrased)
dataset_th: ความลึกของน้ำท่วมตามรายงานข่าว ณ สถานที่ที่ระบุชื่อในอำเภอแม่สาย 10–13 ก.ย. 2567 (2024) (ข่าวภาษาไทยและอังกฤษ เรียบเรียงใหม่)
compiled_by: FloodGuard desk research of Thai and English news (roadmap C-2), read by a second checker whose corrections are applied; locations from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) and place listings.
status_th: ตามรายงาน (คำบอกเล่า ไม่ได้สำรวจ)
confidence_reason: Anecdotal news reports, not surveys: depths are lower bounds, ranges or body and storey references, several statements cover more than one community, times are article times rather than measurement times, and most locations are community or street points.
use_rule: A consistency check only. The reported depths are never used to tune the model: no keyframe, depth-factor or terrain change may be set from them.
licence_note: Facts with citations. Each report is paraphrased in the project's own words; only the article title is quoted, as a citation. Coordinates matched to OpenStreetMap stay under ODbL 1.0.
copyright_rule: Paraphrase only: no sentence of an article is copied, a title is cited at most once per report and is no longer than 160 characters, and a record carries at most one quoted phrase of under 15 words per source.
location_rule: A point is given only where the location confidence is medium or high. location_tolerance_m is how far the reported spot may lie from the point, read from the location basis.
time_rule: Each report has a window in local time (ICT, UTC+7). It ends at the article's time stamp, because a report cannot describe a later moment, and starts at the earliest time the text allows.
depth_rule: Numbers are kept as the source gives them: a lower bound (more than 1 m) or a range (2-3 m in places, whose lower end is the lower bound). A storey or body reference is kept as a class and never turned into a number.
assumptions: The depths are what reporters and residents said, not measurements; none was surveyed or checked on the ground.
A statement that names several communities is recorded once per community, with the same words and a note that it is shared.
Community and street points are centroids of mapped streets or a nearby landmark; the reported spot may lie up to location_tolerance_m away.
Reports of other floods (August and early October 2024, 2025, 2022) and of places outside Mae Sai district are left out.
